Defragmentation (Defrag): Hardware memory (VRAM / RAM) and storage layout
Deduplication (Dedupe): Dataset tokens, embeddings, corpus text, or vector stores

Defragmentation (Defrag): Non-contiguous memory allocation causing false Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors and I/O latency
Deduplication (Dedupe): Repeated documents/tokens causing model overfitting, memorization, training bias, and wasted compute

Defragmentation (Defrag): Content-preserving; no information or sample count changes
Deduplication (Dedupe): Content-reducing; removes duplicate samples, tokens, or rows
